explication: This is a Bloomberg Terminal-style market dashboard. Users enter the terminal, choose market, news, movers, volatility, or RMI views, and inspect market information through tables, charts, and analysis. The client uses React Query and Jotai for fetching and UI state; server routes serve market data using Alpha Vantage, fallback data, and Redis. The README documents watchlists, keyboard controls, theme switching, and responsive behavior. Some view and interaction wiring is only listed in the source index, so unsampled links are omitted or marked unverified.
